about.title: About
about.text: Duble finds duplicate clothing in GTA V packs. A duplicate is the same model AND the same textures — the same model with a different texture is a retexture, a separate item the program never removes. Nothing is deleted: losing files move to a folder next to the pack, and one click brings them back.
about.engine: Engine: Duble.Core (C#, CodeWalker.Core). Interface: WebView2 + HTML/CSS/JS.
